name: Algolean.Algorithms.finFunSplitEquiv_apply_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finFunSplitEquiv_apply_fst (m k : ℕ) (α : Type*)
    (f : Fin (m + k) → α) (i : Fin m) :
    (finFunSplitEquiv m k α f).1 i = f (Fin.castAdd k i)

name: Algolean.Algorithms.finFunSplitEquiv_apply_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finFunSplitEquiv_apply_snd (m k : ℕ) (α : Type*)
    (f : Fin (m + k) → α) (j : Fin k) :
    (finFunSplitEquiv m k α f).2 j = f (Fin.natAdd m j)

name: Algolean.Algorithms.finFunSplitEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finFunSplitEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd (m k : ℕ) (α : Type*)
    (p : (Fin m → α) × (Fin k → α)) (i : Fin m) :
    (finFunSplitEquiv m k α).symm p (Fin.castAdd k i) = p.1 i

name: Algolean.Algorithms.finFunSplitEquiv_symm_apply_natAdd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finFunSplitEquiv_symm_apply_natAdd (m k : ℕ) (α : Type*)
    (p : (Fin m → α) × (Fin k → α)) (j : Fin k) :
    (finFunSplitEquiv m k α).symm p (Fin.natAdd m j) = p.2 j

name: Algolean.Algorithms.cnotAction_involutive
statement:
lemma cnotAction_involutive {n : ℕ} {c t : Fin n} (h : c ≠ t) :
    Function.Involutive (cnotAction c t)

name: Algolean.Algorithms.fin2_sub_sub_self
statement: lemma fin2_sub_sub_self (b : Fin 2) : (1 : Fin 2) - (1 - b) = b
